nan_boundary.sql: SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f NULLS LAST) AS r, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f NULLS LAST) AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f ORDER BY id) AS n FROM wr_float_boundary ORDER BY id
nan_boundary.reason: Existing Assay GROUP BY preserves NaN payloads; window keys deliberately retain that equality contract. This explicitly reported difference is outside the 80 shared-domain goldens.
nan_boundary.sqlite: NaN payloads are not representable by the SQLite SQL fixture interface.
